# TTL Indexes — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for TTL Indexes. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-24 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] TTL cleanup is asynchronous. The background task runs every 60 seconds, but because removal duration depends on workload, expired data may exist for some time beyond that interval. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-index-usage-and-mongodb-explain-part-1/, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Use BSON Date values or arrays containing dates. The earliest date in an array determines expiration. Missing fields and fields without date values do not expire documents; schema validation can prevent these silent retention gaps. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/expire-data.md
- [statement] Use collMod to change an existing TTL index’s expireAfterSeconds without rebuilding the index; createIndex is not the mechanism for changing this setting. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/expire-data.md
- [statement] Create a single-field TTL index with createIndex({createdAt: 1}, {expireAfterSeconds: 3600}) to expire documents one hour after their stored createdAt date. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/expire-data.md
- [statement] Use collMod to change an existing TTL duration without rebuilding the index. Lowering retention or adding TTL to old data can create a delete backlog; pre-delete in batches and schedule the change during quiet periods. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] TTL requires a single-field index; compound indexes do not implement TTL, and the _id index cannot carry the TTL option. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-index-usage-and-mongodb-explain-part-1/, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb
- [statement] Since MongoDB 7.0, time-series partial TTL indexes use timeField keys and metaField filters for shorter retention on matching data. Bucket deletion waits until all contained measurements expire; longer partial retention cannot override a shorter collection-wide retention period. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md
- [statement] TTL cleanup alone cannot guarantee timely removal of expired records, because MongoDB does not guarantee that expired data is deleted immediately upon expiration. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/expire-data.md
- [statement] For PBM logical restores of time series collections with collection-level expireAfterSeconds, Percona warns that TTL can remove buckets needed by oplog replay. Its current procedure disables the monitor on each data-bearing target and restores its original setting afterward; it explicitly excludes regular TTL indexes from this failure. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-05) — https://docs.percona.com/percona-backup-mongodb/latest/usage/restore.html

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] TTL indexes automatically delete whole documents after the indexed date plus expireAfterSeconds. They suit bounded-lifetime logs and sessions; expiration depends on the field value, rather than insertion time unless the application stores insertion time there. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-index-usage-and-mongodb-explain-part-1/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/expire-data.md
- [statement] Inspect db.currentOp() and serverStatus metrics.ttl.deletedDocuments and metrics.ttl.passes to observe TTL activity. These report cleanup activity rather than proving that no expired documents remain. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb

## Facts and statements

- [statement] For per-document deadlines, index a BSON Date field such as expireAt and set expireAfterSeconds to 0. The stored date determines eligibility, not an exact deletion appointment. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/expire-data.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb
- [statement] In replica sets, the TTL monitor deletes only on the primary. Secondaries replicate the resulting deletions; cleanup consumes normal write and replication resources. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-index-usage-and-mongodb-explain-part-1/, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb
- [statement] Building a TTL index over old data or shortening retention can expose a large deletion backlog. Estimate eligible data, delete in controlled batches, and schedule the change during off-peak hours. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb
- [statement] A TTL index with zero $indexStats accesses.ops is not necessarily unused: this counter excludes internal TTL deletion activity. Dropping it based on this counter alone can silently remove automatic retention. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/
- [statement] The documented monitor is single-threaded. It advances from an index after deleting 50,000 documents, spending one second, or exhausting its expired documents; passes and sub-passes share cleanup opportunities across indexes. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-16) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb
- [statement] Never configure expireAfterSeconds as NaN. MongoDB 5.0.0–5.0.13 and 6.0.0–6.0.1 treated NaN as zero, risking immediate expiration; 5.0.14 and 6.0.2 onward ignore such malformed TTL indexes according to the documented compatibility history. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/expire-data.md
- [statement] SERVER-92779 reports that if more than TTLIndexDeleteTargetDocs expired orphan (unowned) documents exist for a TTL index, more recently expired documents cannot be removed by the TTLMonitor through the index. The issue lists 6.1.0-rc0, 7.0.0 and 8.0.0 as affected and was Unresolved with no fix version when last updated on Oct 30 2026. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92779 — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-92779
- [statement] SERVER-56274 documented much slower TTL deletion with descending indexes on MongoDB 4.4.0 and records resolution in October 2022. Treat this as a historical performance defect, not a universal rule that descending TTL indexes are unsupported. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-56274
- [statement] TTL deletion leaves empty WiredTiger records available for reuse but does not normally return that space to the operating system; compact or replica-set resync can release it. (high confidence) Sources: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/compact.md — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/faq/storage.md
- [statement] The manual dates conversion of an existing single-field index to TTL through collMod to MongoDB 5.1. Alibaba Cloud's ApsaraDB for MongoDB guide documents this capability from 6.0 for its product; distinguish that product baseline from the original MongoDB introduction. (medium confidence) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md ; https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb
- [statement] Alibaba Cloud's ApsaraDB for MongoDB guide recommends adding a random offset to spread synchronized TTL expirations and avoid CPU spikes from mass deletions; for retention periods of at least 24 hours, it recommends a 0-to-10-minute offset. (low confidence) — http://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb
- [statement] MongoDB's manual dates batched TTL deletions and the BATCHED_DELETE explain stage to 6.1. Alibaba Cloud's ApsaraDB for MongoDB guide describes the batched delete optimization as MongoDB 7.0+ and says the feature was originally introduced in development version 6.1. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md ; https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md · keywords: TTL Indexes · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/best-practices-for-ttl-indexes-in-apsaradb-for-mongodb
- [statement] A 2015 performance thread initially blamed TTL, but its reporter later identified the tags index after further tests. It does not establish a general TTL throughput penalty. (low confidence) — https://groups.google.com/g/mongodb-user/c/wXnA4OE5fC0
